#include "plain_c.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static const char *names[] = {"a", "b", NULL};

int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }

size_t count(const char *s) {
    size_t n = 0;
    for (; *s; ++s) if (*s == 'x') n++;
    return n;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    (void)argc; (void)argv;
    point_t p = {.x = 1, .y = 2};
    int *buf = malloc(sizeof *buf * 4);
    if (!buf) return 1;
    memset(buf, 0, sizeof *buf * 4);
    printf("%d %zu %s\n", add(p.x, p.y), count("xx"), names[0]);
    free(buf);
    return 0;
}
